title: Shared source-tracked proficiency grant (all class apps)

source_id.description: Class feature, subclass, species, background, feat, item or campaign override identifier

target.description: Namespaced identifier, e.g. skill:persuasion or weapon-category:martial

description: Unconditional resolved grants use the reference resolver. Conditional feature effects and unresolved choice sets must be evaluated before calling it; languages/armor are training flags rather than numeric check bonuses.
